.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/task/solution/app/server.js, package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.mjs, public/index.html, public/runner.html, public/assets/index.js
evidence: Parsed in this review on the frozen bytes. Python tomllib loads task/task.toml, tests/scoring.toml and all five judge.toml files with no error; all are LF with no BOM. Criterion counts: render 1, constraints 2, functional 42, polish 6, visual 3; 54 ids/names with no duplicate; every criterion carries id, name, description, type and weight (visual also points). Each judge.toml sets prompt_template = "prompt.md" (line 6) and that file exists beside it and contains the {app_context} placeholder that tests/test.sh:195-201 substitutes. scoring.toml keys [gates] render/constraints, [weights] functional/polish/visual, [floors] functional match the suite directories. `bash -n` exits 0 for tests/test.sh and solution/solve.sh; both begin `#!/bin/bash\nset -euo pipefail`, contain no CR byte and end with a newline. tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, environment/Dockerfile, tests/tools/score.py and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template; both Python tools pass ast.parse. Reference entry: `node --check` passes for solution/app/server.js and for the shipped bundle solution/app/public/assets/index.js; server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5), both of which the agent and verifier images install globally at the versions pinned in package.json and expose through NODE_PATH (tests/test.sh:106); root is __dirname (server.js:7) so the launch from a cwd outside /app resolves; it honours DB_PATH (server.js:8) and listens on 0.0.0.0:PORT||3000 (server.js:142), matching tests/test.sh:104-111. solve.sh copies solution/app to /app, so /app/server.js exists for the test.sh:68 guard, and public/index.html references /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, both present. package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json and seed_data.json are valid JSON. Would-run evidence: the scripted golden record in raw-evidence-index.json is bound to this input hash and its artifact hashes verify; it installed with solve.sh and launched as test.sh does (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH, cwd outside /app) with one real restart, and runtime/editor/polish results show the app serving and no pageErrors. Limitation, not a defect of this row: tests/test.sh inside the verifier image and the configured judge have not been run on these exact bytes (the hosted Oracle 0.9833 run is on an earlier candidate); the launcher is unchanged template bytes. Counterexample attempts found nothing: no CRLF, BOM, missing prompt file, duplicate criterion id, unresolvable require or stale asset reference. Local node is v24, the images use node 22; server.js uses no syntax beyond node 22.
